text: This report seeks the approval of the Board of the Toronto Parking Authority ("TPA") to enter into a parking management agreement ("Agreement") with WDL 3/4/7 LP ("WDL") in order to manage a 450-space surface parking lot located at 373 Front Street East (also known as Municipal Carpark 289) (the "Subject Property" or "Parking Facility"), for a two (2) year term, in accordance with the terms and conditions outlined in Table 2.0 - Summary of Parking Management Agreement, and Appendix D - Toronto Parking Authority and WDL Obligations, of this report. City Legal has been engaged to review the necessary documents.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized staff to enter into a parking management agreement with WDL 3/4/7 LP (WDL) to manage a 450-space surface parking lot located at 373 Front Street East, in accordance with the terms and conditions as generally outlined in Table 2.0 - Summary of Parking Management Agreement, and Appendix D - Toronto Parking Authority and WDL Obligations to the report (September 10, 2018) from the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority, and on such other or amended terms and conditions as may be acceptable to the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority and in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor. 2. Approved the parking rate for 373 Front Street East as identified in Table 2.0 - Summary of Parking Management Agreement to the report (September 10, 2018) from the Acting President, Toronto Parking Authority to be implemented…
